name: Quaternity
bio:
We are a four-piece jazz group from Fresno, California, playing originals, standards, arrangements of popular tunes, and other fun stuff. We like to dabble in a bit of everything, with improvisation at the heart of what we do. We’re equally at home playing a straight-ahead jazz gig or getting experimental and a little out there.

Check out the Listen section for a taste of what we’re about. If you’re a venue or promoter, feel free to reach out through the Contact section. Thanks for dropping by!
